Custom split-leg shorts: buyer questions

Can we customize the split-leg design with our own logo?

Yes. Develop your own geometric artwork, panel colors, academy or brand logo, labels and packaging. Provide authorized artwork and approve placement on the sample.

Which fabric composition and weight should we choose?

Confirm composition, GSM, stretch, opacity and drying requirements using a swatch and physical sample. The reference photographs do not establish test results or exact fiber percentages.

What should we check on the side slits and waistband?

Approve slit depth, hem finish, reinforcement at stress points, relaxed and stretched waist measurements, and fit during movement. Confirm the final stitch construction through sampling.

What are the MOQ and sampling requirements?

MOQ and sample arrangements depend on fabric, design, colors, sizes and branding. Send your quantity, size allocation, logo or reference and target delivery date for a project-specific quotation.

Are these real product photos and what does the review cover?

The front and back images are supplied customer photographs. The Australian five-star review dated June 6, 2024 describes professional service and an intention to order again. The video is a generated design presentation, not production or performance evidence.
